rules: Never infer a fee or salary from market value.
Never convert a loan into a permanent transfer without a source.
Option-to-buy and obligation-to-buy are separate fields.
Parent-club contract and loan-club registration are separate relationships.
Conflicting sources are retained for review rather than silently overwritten.
coverage_warning: The public Transfermarkt dataset used for bulk contract fields is only current to 2026-07-06 and does not cover 2026/27 squads, so it is not sufficient by itself for the September 2026 snapshot. Current-season loan records are therefore being verified from official league/club sources first.
